<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <g font-family="TT Commons, Arial, sans-serif">
    <!-- Status bar -->
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="24" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="18" y="17" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="600" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
    <g stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none">
      <line x1="321" y1="16" x2="321" y2="12"/>
      <line x1="326" y1="16" x2="326" y2="10"/>
      <line x1="331" y1="16" x2="331" y2="8"/>
      <line x1="336" y1="16" x2="336" y2="6"/>
      <circle cx="351" cy="12" r="3"/>
      <line x1="347" y1="16" x2="355" y2="8"/>
    </g>
    <rect x="362" y="7" width="20" height="11" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.3"/>
    <rect x="383" y="10" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="364" y="9" width="15" height="7" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>

    <!-- Header -->
    <rect x="0" y="24" width="390" height="50" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="73.5" x2="390" y2="73.5" stroke="#EFEFEF" stroke-width="1"/>
    <polyline points="25,40 18,49 25,58" fill="none" stroke="#7060EA" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="195" y="46" text-anchor="middle" font-size="19" font-weight="600" fill="#000000">Group chat</text>
    <text x="195" y="64" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" fill="#A7A7A7">Maya, Daniel, Sofia and 2 others</text>
    <g stroke="#B4B4B4" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none">
      <circle cx="342" cy="45" r="8"/>
      <line x1="338" y1="45" x2="346" y2="45"/>
      <line x1="342" y1="41" x2="342" y2="49"/>
      <rect x="363" y="39" width="13" height="10" rx="2"/>
      <polygon points="376,42 381,39 381,49 376,46" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    </g>

    <!-- Chat content -->
    <rect x="0" y="74" width="390" height="500" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="20" y1="101" x2="157" y2="101" stroke="#EFEFEF"/>
    <line x1="233" y1="101" x2="370" y2="101" stroke="#EFEFEF"/>
    <text x="195" y="106" text-anchor="middle" font-size="15" fill="#B1B1B1">Today</text>

    <!-- Maya message -->
    <circle cx="25" cy="135" r="15" fill="#BA6FEC"/>
    <text x="25" y="140" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">M</text>
    <text x="48" y="122" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#000000">Maya Chen</text>
    <rect x="48" y="128" width="220" height="38" rx="0" fill="#EFEFEF"/>
    <rect x="48" y="128" width="220" height="38" rx="12" fill="#EFEFEF"/>
    <rect x="48" y="128" width="12" height="38" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="60" y="145" font-size="13.6" fill="#000000">Morning everyone! Are we still</text>
    <text x="60" y="160" font-size="13.6" fill="#000000">on for lunch at 12:30?</text>
    <text x="275" y="161" font-size="12" fill="#A7A7A7">9:18</text>

    <!-- Daniel reply -->
    <circle cx="25" cy="197" r="15" fill="#8275EB"/>
    <text x="25" y="202" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">D</text>
    <text x="48" y="184" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#000000">Daniel Ortiz</text>
    <rect x="48" y="190" width="245" height="38" rx="12" fill="#EFEFEF"/>
    <rect x="48" y="190" width="12" height="38" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="60" y="207" font-size="13.6" fill="#000000">Absolutely. I found a great place</text>
    <text x="60" y="222" font-size="13.6" fill="#000000">near the station.</text>
    <text x="300" y="223" font-size="12" fill="#A7A7A7">9:20</text>
    <circle cx="75" cy="238" r="12" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#B4B4B4" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="75" y="243" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" fill="#7060EA">♥</text>
    <text x="91" y="243" font-size="12" fill="#B1B1B1">2</text>

    <!-- Sofia message -->
    <circle cx="25" cy="278" r="15" fill="#B4B4B4"/>
    <text x="25" y="283" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">S</text>
    <text x="48" y="265" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#000000">Sofia Rossi</text>
    <rect x="48" y="271" width="215" height="38" rx="12" fill="#EFEFEF"/>
    <rect x="48" y="271" width="12" height="38" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="60" y="288" font-size="13.6" fill="#000000">Count me in! I can bring dessert</text>
    <text x="60" y="303" font-size="13.6" fill="#000000">from the bakery downstairs.</text>
    <text x="270" y="304" font-size="12" fill="#A7A7A7">9:22</text>

    <!-- User sent message -->
    <circle cx="365" cy="344" r="15" fill="#7060EA"/>
    <text x="365" y="349" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">A</text>
    <rect x="126" y="327" width="231" height="38" rx="12" fill="#8275EB"/>
    <rect x="345" y="327" width="12" height="38" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="138" y="344" font-size="13.6" fill="#FFFFFF">Perfect, I'll reserve a table for</text>
    <text x="138" y="359" font-size="13.6" fill="#FFFFFF">five. See you soon 😊</text>
    <text x="102" y="360" font-size="12" fill="#A7A7A7">9:24</text>
    <polyline points="347,371 351,375 358,367" fill="none" stroke="#7060EA" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="143" cy="383" r="12" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#B4B4B4" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="143" y="388" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" fill="#7060EA">♥</text>
    <text x="159" y="388" font-size="12" fill="#B1B1B1">3</text>

    <!-- Leo message -->
    <circle cx="25" cy="425" r="15" fill="#A7A7A7"/>
    <text x="25" y="430" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">L</text>
    <text x="48" y="412" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#000000">Leo Martins</text>
    <rect x="48" y="418" width="260" height="38" rx="12" fill="#EFEFEF"/>
    <rect x="48" y="418" width="12" height="38" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="60" y="435" font-size="13.6" fill="#000000">I just shared the address here —</text>
    <text x="60" y="450" font-size="13.6" fill="#000000">it is called The Green Table.</text>
    <text x="315" y="451" font-size="12" fill="#A7A7A7">9:26</text>
    <circle cx="76" cy="467" r="12" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#B4B4B4" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="76" y="472" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" fill="#7060EA">♥</text>
    <text x="92" y="472" font-size="12" fill="#B1B1B1">1</text>

    <!-- Maya final -->
    <circle cx="25" cy="514" r="15" fill="#BA6FEC"/>
    <text x="25" y="519" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">M</text>
    <rect x="48" y="496" width="172" height="38" rx="12" fill="#EFEFEF"/>
    <rect x="48" y="496" width="12" height="38" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="60" y="513" font-size="13.6" fill="#000000">Sounds delicious! See you all</text>
    <text x="60" y="528" font-size="13.6" fill="#000000">at 12:30 ❤️</text>
    <text x="228" y="529" font-size="12" fill="#A7A7A7">9:28</text>
    <circle cx="76" cy="546" r="12" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#B4B4B4" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="76" y="551" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" fill="#7060EA">♥</text>
    <text x="92" y="551" font-size="12" fill="#B1B1B1">4</text>

    <!-- Composer -->
    <rect x="0" y="574" width="390" height="110" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#000000" stroke-opacity=".15" stroke-width="1"/>
    <rect x="15" y="587" width="300" height="39" rx="19" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#B4B4B4" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="34" cy="606" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#B4B4B4" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <line x1="39" y1="611" x2="44" y2="616" stroke="#B4B4B4" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <text x="54" y="612" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#A7A7A7">Write a message</text>
    <g>
      <circle cx="341" cy="606" r="21" fill="#8275EB"/>
      <rect x="337" y="596" width="8" height="15" rx="4" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.3"/>
      <line x1="333" y1="605" x2="333" y2="608" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.3"/>
      <line x1="349" y1="605" x2="349" y2="608" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.3"/>
      <line x1="333" y1="608" x2="349" y2="608" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.3"/>
      <line x1="341" y1="608" x2="341" y2="613" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.3"/>
    </g>
    <g opacity=".7">
      <circle cx="378" cy="606" r="21" fill="#8275EB"/>
      <line x1="371" y1="606" x2="385" y2="606" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <line x1="378" y1="599" x2="378" y2="613" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    </g>
    <line x1="15" y1="649" x2="375" y2="649" stroke="#EFEFEF"/>
    <g stroke="#B4B4B4" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none">
      <rect x="25" y="659" width="22" height="16" rx="2"/>
      <circle cx="31" cy="664" r="2"/>
      <polygon points="27,672 33,666 38,671 42,668 46,674"/>
      <circle cx="91" cy="667" r="8"/>
      <line x1="91" y1="661" x2="91" y2="673"/>
      <line x1="85" y1="667" x2="97" y2="667"/>
      <circle cx="155" cy="667" r="8"/>
      <line x1="150" y1="662" x2="160" y2="672"/>
      <line x1="160" y1="662" x2="150" y2="672"/>
      <circle cx="219" cy="667" r="8"/>
      <polyline points="214,667 218,671 225,663"/>
      <circle cx="283" cy="667" r="8"/>
      <line x1="279" y1="667" x2="287" y2="667"/>
    </g>

    <!-- Bottom navigation -->
    <rect x="0" y="684" width="390" height="126" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="684" x2="390" y2="684" stroke="#EFEFEF"/>
    <g stroke="#B4B4B4" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none">
      <polygon points="38,711 48,702 58,711 58,722 38,722"/>
      <polyline points="38,711 48,702 58,711"/>
      <rect x="108" y="705" width="22" height="16" rx="5"/>
      <polygon points="113,721 116,725 120,721"/>
      <circle cx="195" cy="713" r="10"/>
      <line x1="195" y1="707" x2="195" y2="719"/>
      <line x1="189" y1="713" x2="201" y2="713"/>
      <circle cx="272" cy="711" r="7"/>
      <ellipse cx="272" cy="722" rx="12" ry="5"/>
      <circle cx="348" cy="710" r="8"/>
      <circle cx="348" cy="710" r="3"/>
      <line x1="348" y1="696" x2="348" y2="700"/>
      <line x1="334" y1="710" x2="338" y2="710"/>
      <line x1="358" y1="710" x2="362" y2="710"/>
    </g>
    <text x="48" y="739" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" fill="#A7A7A7">Chats</text>
    <text x="119" y="739" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" fill="#A7A7A7">Calls</text>
    <text x="195" y="739" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" fill="#A7A7A7">Explore</text>
    <text x="272" y="739" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" fill="#A7A7A7">Contacts</text>
    <text x="348" y="739" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" fill="#A7A7A7">More</text>
    <rect x="0" y="810" width="390" height="34" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="145" y="824" width="100" height="5" rx="3" fill="#000000"/>
  </g>
</svg>
